requirements.title: SCALE representable result multiplies by a radix power
requirements.definition: For representable results, SCALE(X,I) has value X multiplied by b**I, with b defined by the real model for X.

pending.SCALE-representable-radix-power: Use X=FRACTION(1.0) and I=EXPONENT(1.0)+1; assert EXPONENT(SCALE(X,I))==I and FRACTION(SCALE(X,I))==X rather than a hard-coded model value, initialize the observed result to a negative sentinel, and mutate I to zero.
pending.SCALE-negative-exponent: Use X=SET_EXPONENT(FRACTION(1.0), EXPONENT(1.0)+1) and I=-1; assert EXPONENT(SCALE(X,I))==EXPONENT(X)-1 and FRACTION(SCALE(X,I))==FRACTION(X), and mutate the exponent sign.
